components.label: Poverty & human development
components.help: Poorer, less developed places score higher.

components.label: Road access
components.help: Fewer roads and longer distances score higher.

components.label: Terrain & land cover
components.help: Rugged, forested or wet land scores higher.

components.label: Solar & wind resource
components.help: Stronger sun and wind score higher.

types.name: Mountainous, low wind
types.description: High ground (median about 1,400 m), almost no roads, far from a main road, weak wind. All 16 are in Papua.

types.name: Windy, well connected
types.description: Good wind, a dense road network and busy night lights. Mostly Java-Bali and Sumatra.

types.name: Windy, less connected
types.description: The strongest solar and good wind, but fewer roads. Mostly Sulawesi and Nusa Tenggara.

types.name: Flat, best connected
types.description: Flat and highly built up, with the densest roads and the brightest nights. Mostly Java-Bali.

types.name: Low wind, mixed terrain
types.description: The largest group: weaker wind, dense tree cover and a mix of hills and plains. Mostly Sumatra and Kalimantan.

types.name: Flat, vegetated, windy
types.description: Flat land with the best wind of all seven types and moderate road access. Mostly Sumatra and Kalimantan.

types.name: Flat, densely vegetated, remote
types.description: Flat land with few roads and almost no night light, a long way from a main road. Mostly Kalimantan.

sources.source: Ministry of Villages regulation No. 11/2025 (Strategic Plan 2025-2029)
